execution_backend: Eight concurrent independent subprocess workers; file IPC (Windows denied multiprocessing pipe)

P5.interpretation: At least as good: no larger L on each prescribed paired case; no privileged run on 41.

conventions.group_errors: Pooled finite estimator returns; missing outputs counted, never held or imputed.
conventions.segments: D.masks_for on each own full control-grid k_eff and fax, sampled at estimator ticks; events separate.
conventions.force_rms: Pooled full control-grid force samples using same masks; fast=rise|fall|reversal.
conventions.sustained: D.sustained: 13 contiguous control ticks outside events; missing/skipped calls break windows.
conventions.privileged_startup: Retain raw before 12 filter ticks; then prescribed correction without additional estimator clipping; controller retains its own gain bounds.
conventions.filter_history: Estimator-call history; discontinuous n resets filter and trailing histories.
conventions.privileged_scope: 36-40 only: aggregate excludes 41; slow privileged identification contains 38 only.

prespecified_predictions.Q1: A_large mean L <= .22; every delag-huber case delta <= .02.
prespecified_predictions.Q2: Cases 0-23 delta <= .05; group mean delta within +/-.02, allowing A_slow_thin improvement through case 7.
prespecified_predictions.Q3: Pooled A_large fast rise mean log error within +/-.06; fall mean < +.12.
prespecified_predictions.Q4: Each A_large fast case: beta > .05 for >50% of t>3 ticks; each B case median beta < .1.

Q4.convention: For each case, estimator ticks t > 3; most means strictly over half; beta is the gain used.

conventions.beta: Gain used before current tick update; all ticks included in t>3 statistics.
conventions.history: Every estimator call, including invalid windows; nonconsecutive n resets all delag histories and gain sums.
conventions.contact: Gain update requires F>=1 at all 25 ticks j-24 through j, inclusive.
conventions.decay: Sums decay only on eligible gain updates, as prescribed.
conventions.scoring: Unchanged round-1 masks, returned-stiffness log error, and pooled force RMS.
